channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Ramstad: The term ‘horrible year’ is inadequate for the pain nonprofits have felt in 2025
item.description: Kate Barr, a longtime leader on Minnesota’s nonprofit scene, says a big difference this year is charities have suffered alone.

item.title: We tested AI shopping chatbots. This is what we found.
item.description: As Target and Walmart signed OpenAI agreements and touted new ways of holiday shopping, we decided to see how well they worked.

item.title: Anderson: A trigger once pulled can never be unpulled — a lesson some hunters learn the hard way
item.description: Some hunters drink or otherwise cause their own problems. Others are unprepared for dizzying effects of “buck fever.”

item.title: Wild President Bill Guerin delighted at trade that landed Quinn Hughes from Vancouver
item.description: Said Guerin: “They got three really good young players that are going to help build their team, and we got a franchise defenseman.”

item.title: Subzero temperatures roll into Minnesota this weekend
item.description: Forecasters expect wind chills will fall to 35 degrees below zero.

item.title: Can J.J. McCarthy make progress in the Vikings’ progression-based offense?
item.description: Tom Brady and Kurt Warner have criticized the pure progression scheme the Vikings and many other teams use for stunting young quarterbacks’ growth by not asking them to decipher coverages.

item.title: ICE agents visit Brooklyn Park coffee shop, arrest cook after ruse to get him outside
item.description: The ICE operation in the Twin Cities is increasingly moving into the suburbs.

item.title: Judge strikes down rollout of Minnesota law aimed at protecting Black families
item.description: The legality of the Minnesota African American Family Preservation and Child Welfare Disproportionality Act is being called into question.

item.title: Police search Brown University after shooter kills 2 and wounds 9 on campus
item.description: A shooter dressed in black killed at least two people and wounded nine others at Brown University on Saturday during final exams on the Ivy League campus, authorities said, and police were searching for the suspect.

item.title: The Minnesota mom who ignited RFK’s vaccine concerns and today’s MAHA movement
item.description: Sarah Bridges’ advocacy followed a seven-year fight to get the federal government to recognize her son’s disability as a vaccine injury.
